# Surfaces versions

A project's context file records the surfaces version it carries in its project-surfaces section.
Each version below has one line here and a file in `changes/` listing what it gives a project set
up at an earlier version. The last line is the newest version; `../SKILL.md` → *The update pass*
says how an update reads and offers them, and when it records the newest.

- v1 — `changes/v1.md`: decision records name the check that enforces them; a verification surface per artifact.
- v2 — `changes/v2.md`: setup audits the whole setup; surfaces judged fit to trust by their jobs; a fixed feature-map shape.
- v3 — `changes/v3.md`: the feature-map entry says where its commands live and that a changed feature's entry is updated and driven.
- v4 — `changes/v4.md`: one verification harness of recipes replaces the surface, map and reader tasks.
- v5 — `changes/v5.md`: the harness is optional, controls what it checks, holds run time against creep, and reads as a default shape.
- v6 — `changes/v6.md`: every check a harness project keeps is a recipe, the checks run across the whole tree included, and the evidence a change rests on comes through the harness.
- v7 — `changes/v7.md`: the harness commits no evidence and keeps no status, and each timed scenario's line lives in its recipe.
- v8 — `changes/v8.md`: the North Star holds only what decisions are judged against, in six sections; chosen options move to decision records, guiding ones under the `Strategy` area, on the owner's ruling.
- v9 — `changes/v9.md`: the North Star's Purpose opens with the end, and the end gets a measure of its own; decision records carry a `Revisit when` signpost the strategy list shows; setup offers a check that rebuilds the index and the list.
- v10 — `changes/v10.md`: scoped project instructions, delegated record maintenance, and optional coordination preparation.
- v11 — `changes/v11.md`: decision records give grounds, not a veto, and unattended runs reopen them where a need makes sense and report it first; North Star lines get a fit check before they cut an option.
- v12 — `changes/v12.md`: time lines are removed — no `Line:` or `Workload:` field, no `headroom:` or `raise:` setting, no `line`, `raise` or `freeze` command and no exit 5 — and runs report their duration as the only time signal.
